name: Selank
summary: Selank is a synthetic heptapeptide analogue of the endogenous tetrapeptide tuftsin, with the sequence Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro. Russian clinical papers have studied it as an anxiolytic with a mild nootropic effect, often by the nasal route. Human trials exist, so the catalog grade is early human evidence, not a South African registered medicine. SAHPRA names Selank among illegally marketed peptides. A Russian drug status, if any, is not SAHPRA registration.

research_uses.use: Anxiety disorders, including generalized anxiety, phobic-anxiety, and somatoform presentations, compared with benzodiazepines in Russian clinical papers

sources.title: Efficacy and possible mechanisms of action of a new peptide anxiolytic selank in the therapy of generalized anxiety disorders and neurasthenia
sources.quote: Sixty-two patients with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) and neurasthenia were studied. The effect of selank (30 patients) was compared to that of medazepam (32 patients).

sources.title: A comparison of the anxiolytic effect and tolerability of selank and phenazepam in the treatment of anxiety disorders
sources.quote: A comparative study of the anxiolytic effect and tolerability of selank and phenazepam was carried out in 60 patients with phobic-anxiety- and somatoform disorders. Results Pronounced anxiolytic and mild nootropic effects of selank were demonstrated.

research_uses.use: Nootropic and cognitive research, including a mild nootropic signal in anxiety trials and resting-state fMRI in healthy adults

sources.title: A comparison of the anxiolytic effect and tolerability of selank and phenazepam in the treatment of anxiety disorders
sources.quote: Pronounced anxiolytic and mild nootropic effects of selank were demonstrated.

sources.title: Functional Connectomic Approach to Studying Selank and Semax Effects
sources.quote: The present study was aimed at the assessment of effects of anxiolytic Selank and nootropic Semax on the whole-brain resting-state functional connectivity (FC) of each of the predefined regions of interest (ROIs) in 52 healthy participants.

research_uses.use: Immune-marker and cytokine changes in patients with anxiety-asthenic disorders

sources.title: Immunomodulatory effects of selank in patients with anxiety-asthenic disorders
sources.quote: The changes of the Th1/Th2 cytokine balance in vivo were found in the serum of patients with generalized anxiety disorder and neurasthenia who received Selank during 14 days.

sahpra.notes: SAHPRA names Selank among illegally marketed peptides. A Russian clinical or drug status is not SAHPRA registration. This is not legal advice.

sources.title: SAHPRA peptide products public information
sources.quote: Illegally marketed peptides include: BPC-157, TB-500, Melanotan II, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, PT-141, AOD-9604, Selank, and Semax.

wada.notes: The 2026 Prohibited List examples do not name Selank. BPC-157 is named under S0. Thymosin-beta4 and TB-500 are named under S2.3. Not named is not a clearance for tested athletes.

sources.title: WADA Prohibited List 2026 (PDF)
sources.quote: This class covers many different substances including but not limited to BPC-157, 2,4-dinitrophenol (DNP), ryanodine receptor-1-calstabin complex stabilizers [e.g. S-107, S48168 (ARM210)] and troponin activators (e.g. reldesemtiv and tirasemtiv).

stack_pair_notes.note: A resting-state fMRI study in 52 healthy adults assessed Selank and Semax together. Shared research context is not a protocol.

sources.quote: Heptapeptide Selank (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro) exhibits prolonged anti-anxiety and nootropic effects.

sources.title: Effects of heptapeptide selank on genetically-based and situation-provoked symptoms of depression in behavior in WAG/Rij and Wistar rats, and in BALB/c mice
sources.quote: A synthetic derivative of the endogenous peptide tuftsin heptapeptide selank (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro) possesses an anxiolytic and psychostimulant effect, and represents a working element of a new peptide drug having completed the third phase of the clinical testing as a selective anxiolytic.
